content.title: Neuromuscular Training in Athletes: Integrating Injury Risk Reduction and Athletic Performance Enhancement
content.abstract: Background: Modern athletic competition imposes substantial multi-planar mechanical decelerations, high impact forces, and unpredictable perturbations on the musculoskeletal system. Non-contact soft tissue injuries, most notably anterior cruciate ligament (ACL) disruptions, acute lateral ankle sprains, and hamstring strain injuries—frequently stem from deficits in sensorimotor integration, dynamic joint stabilization, and neuromuscular control.
